svg.title: Loading dock
svg.desc: The front of a distribution center: a raised dock platform with three roll-up doors, dock seals, bumpers, signal lights and a dock light, a rooftop HVAC unit and steps up from the yard. A trailer is parked at the first door. A box truck reverses up to the middle dock, then the lit door rolls up to show pallets of cartons inside. A wrapped pallet waits by the third door.
